const r = await tools.pwsh({
  description: "查看 profiles 与两个记忆插件数据目录",
  command: `
Write-Host '--- profiles ---'
Get-ChildItem "$env:DSH_HOME\\profiles" | Select-Object Name | Out-String
Write-Host '--- profiles/desktop ---'
Get-ChildItem "$env:DSH_HOME\\profiles\\desktop" | Select-Object Name | Out-String
Write-Host '--- .dsh-memory ---'
Get-ChildItem "$env:DSH_HOME\\.dsh-memory" -Recurse -Depth 1 | Select-Object FullName | Out-String
Write-Host '--- openviking plugin dirs in profile ---'
Get-ChildItem "$env:DSH_HOME\\profiles\\desktop\\node_modules\\@openviking" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name | Out-String
`
});
console.log(r.stdout);
